summary: Focused test of the by-product (scrap) confirmation flow on /production-confirmation plus a regression pass on the rest of the page. BACKEND: 19/19 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_byproduct_confirmation.py) - auth gate (401 without vms_session), open-lots & lot/{id} now return a well-formed material_outputs[] per row (product_id, material_output_uuid, unit_code, planned_quantity, open_quantity; no _id leakage), main output always present in material_outputs, at least 4 of the first 100 open lots carry a real by-product line (IRON-SCR / CR-SCRAP), scrap-calc/5989829-1 -> available:true gross 0.49 / net 0.35 / scrap_per_unit 0.14 with scrap_family {CR Iron Scrap, CR-SCRAP} and scrap_per_unit == gross-net, unavailable products return a reason, ConfirmProductionRequest declares confirmed_scrap + all 3 byproduct_* fields, 422 on missing/bad-typed fields, 400 on blank actor, deviation-reasons/history/proposal-history/component-availability all 200. FRONTEND (live, real SAP data, synthetic vms_session deleted after test): BOTH by-product paths were CLICK-TESTED end-to-end. FOUND path (lot 25062 / 100002693-B, whose lot really carries a CR-SCRAP output line; net_weight_kg temporarily seeded 0.09 so scrap-calc became available, reverted after): scrap-calc-info shows Gross 0.112 / Net 0.09 / Scrap/unit 0.022, green data-testid=byproduct-match-found renders, Confirmed Scrap auto-fills to 0.11 after typing qty 5 (= 0.022 x 5), and the intercepted POST /api/production-confirmation/confirm body contained confirmed_scrap 0.11, byproduct_material_output_uuid 15a43e26-...eb16da, byproduct_confirmed_quantity 0.11, byproduct_unit_code KGM - i.e. payload is built correctly from real UI interaction; both toasts appeared ('Confirmation posted to SAP for Lot 25062' + 'By-product CR-SCRAP quantity (0.11 KGM) posted to SAP'). MISSING path (lot 11794 / 6300-000567, classifier expects CR-SCRAP but the lot's only by-product line is IRON-SCR): amber data-testid=byproduct-match-missing renders and the payload correctly sends all three byproduct_* fields as null. Zero console errors in either flow. The POST was intercepted/mocked in the browser so NO new data was written to the live SAP tenant. Regression: Create Production Order card, SoS picker, Fallback Release Order form, proposal-history table, Confirmation History dialog, Manage Reasons dialog and status filter all render and are clickable with no console errors (create/release submits deliberately not fired).

minor.issue: production_confirmation_service.log_confirmation() does not persist byproduct_material_output_uuid / byproduct_confirmed_quantity / byproduct_unit_code nor the result's byproduct_confirmation sub-object, so the Confirmation History has no audit trail of whether the by-product quantity was posted or failed - the only surface is a transient toast.

Cold/slow-SAP call can exceed the 60s ingress timeout -> public URL returns 502 (observed once at 4m0s for limit=20 while SAP was also connect-timing-out on the valuation OData). Under parallel load (pytest -n 4) nearly every production-confirmation endpoint 502'd; serially all pass in ~30s. No caching/pagination on this endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Green found-indicator wording is incomplete/confusing: 'found on this lot, will post KGM quantity to SAP' - it prints only unit_code. Should read e.g. 'will post 0.11 KGM of CR-SCRAP to SAP' (the by-product code + computed quantity).

The by-product toast interpolates byproductMatch?.product_id / unit_code without a guard, so if the backend ever returns byproduct_confirmation while the frontend has no match it renders 'By-product undefined quantity (0.0008 undefined) posted to SAP' (reproduced with an intercepted response). Guard on byproductMatch, or use the values echoed back by the API.

ui_bugs.component: Lot table during manual Look Up
ui_bugs.issue: While lookupManual is in flight (can take 10-60s) the previous 100-row table stays rendered with every Confirm button enabled - a user can open the Confirm dialog for the wrong lot believing the lookup already applied (this bit the first automation run). Disable Confirm buttons / show the skeleton while loading.

integration_issues.issue: Match is exact-equality on scrapCalc.scrap_family.expected_byproduct_code, but real SAP lots do not follow the classifier's family. Lot 11794 (6300-000567, RM 'CR Sheet 1 mm' -> expected CR-SCRAP) actually has an IRON-SCR output line, so the amber 'missing' path fires and the scrap is silently NOT posted even though a by-product line exists. Same risk for 5989829-1 (now classified CR-SCRAP after iteration_86's CR rule, yet its lot 69971 by-product that was live-posted last session was IRON-SCR). Consider falling back to 'the single non-main-output line' (or any known scrap code) when the expected code isn't present, or surface a picker.

issues: 'Requested End Date' uses the browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy spinner) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere
SoS picker area shows only the text 'Checking available Production Models...' for several seconds with no spinner/skeleton

action_items: Persist byproduct_* request fields and result['byproduct_confirmation'] in log_confirmation so the Confirmation History shows the by-product posting outcome
Fix the by-product match strategy: exact expected_byproduct_code equality misses real lots (CR-SCRAP expected vs IRON-SCR present on lot 11794 / 5989829-1 lots)
Complete the green indicator wording (show by-product code + computed qty, not just the unit code) and guard the by-product toast against undefined byproductMatch
Disable the lot table's Confirm buttons while a manual Look Up / refresh is in flight
Consider caching or shrinking the open-lots SAP query - it can exceed the 60s ingress timeout and 502 on the public URL
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionConfirmationPage.js is 881 lines with 4 dialogs + 2 tab bodies in one file - split ConfirmDialog / ManageReasonsDialog / HistoryDialog / CreateOrderTab into modules (>700 line guideline).

ConfirmDialog.submit() sends byproduct_confirmed_quantity = the raw Confirmed Scrap value even if the user manually overrode it to something unrelated to the by-product; there is no validation that scrap <= a sane multiple of qty, and no per-unit sanity check before writing to a real SAP tenant.
server.py is 3551 lines - the production-confirmation router should be extracted.
The by-product SAP call is best-effort after the main confirmation, but its failure is only surfaced via a toast and is not persisted (see action item 1) - there is no retry path either.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the tested by-product flows + regression smoke passed (issues logged are UX/robustness, not blockers)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set component_master.net_weight_kg for 100002693-B (0.09) and 6300-000567 (0.003) via tests/_temp_net_weight.py so the scrap-calc 'available' UI block could be exercised - BOTH REVERTED after the test. One synthetic super_admin auth_users/auth_sessions pair (oid TEST-QA-OID) created for the session-cookie login - DELETED after the test. No data written to SAP (the confirm POST was intercepted in the browser).
test_credentials: No end-user login; used a synthetic vms_session cookie per /app/memory/test_credentials.md technique (created + deleted within the test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -o addopts="" - pytest.ini forces xdist -n 4 which hammers SAP's 3-slot concurrency limiter and makes every production-confirmation endpoint 502 at the ingress. Use tests/_setup_pc_session.py to mint a vms_session cookie (the pytest session fixture deletes the same user_id on teardown, so re-mint after a pytest run). For the by-product FOUND path use lot 25062 (100002693-B, has a real CR-SCRAP output line) after `python tests/_temp_net_weight.py set 100002693-B 0.09`; for the MISSING path use lot 11794 (6300-000567 after setting net weight 0.003). Manual Look Up replaces the row list but the old table stays visible while loading - poll until [data-testid=lot-row-0]'s first cell equals the lot id AND the row count is small before clicking confirm-button-0. Intercept **/api/production-confirmation/confirm with page.route and fulfill a mock ({success:true, byproduct_confirmation:{success:true}}) to avoid writing to the live SAP tenant. Both by-product UI paths were CLICK-TESTED this iteration (not just code-reviewed); the real SAP SOAP round trip was NOT re-run (already verified by the dev agent).
rca_of_the_issue: By-product match uses strict equality between the locally-derived scrap family code (_classify_scrap_family on the RM description) and the lot's material_outputs product_ids. SAP's Production Models don't follow that mapping - a 'CR Sheet'/'CR COIL' item can carry an IRON-SCR output line - so a lot with a genuine by-product line falls into the amber 'missing' branch and the calculated scrap is never posted. Reproduced live on lot 11794 (6300-000567, RM SH1.0CR -> expected CR-SCRAP, lot output = IRON-SCR).
